changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 1 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/11806-login-server-unreachable.md`

- names `packages/app-shell/README.md` → `packages/app-shell/README.md` — edited by this change

  > `packages/app-shell/README.md` documents the two new states in its sign-up table. Its `useSignUpOffer` recipe for hosts now asks `decideSignUpOffer` only once the read has answered, and answers `unreachable` for a failed read.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `6c437b07e` (merge-base with origin/main): 23 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 368 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (378 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/38235315266)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`

Inputs read: card objectstack-ai/objectui#12201 (body and all 4 comments: triage 6120236629, claim 6121008577, rider routing 6121124698, os-dev-report 6122271226), PR #12225 (body, 24-file list, net diff `origin/main...c9ba7b82`, merge-base `9646e2e`), and the 43 check-runs on the head, read twice (last at 2026-10-12T10:35:56Z completion): 40 `success`, 3 `skipped` (the two coverage shard rows and `dependabot`, matrix rows that do not run on a PR), 0 failed, 0 `in_progress`. Every derived gate family the diff touches — Type Check, Lint, Test shards 1–8, Test (dist pins), Build & E2E, Changeset Declaration / Bump Policy / Claim Re-read / Fixed Group, Docs Route Eager Closure Check, README Export Check, Governed Surface Queue Guard — is green on this head. The two gates the dev reported NOT MEASURED locally (`check:eager-locale-catalogues`, `check:readme-exports`) are measured by CI here and pass.

### ① Derived judgments

Each accept-set or public-surface change the diff implies, with its verdict:

1. **`@object-ui/app-shell` · `AppSwitcher` (exported via `layout/index.ts` → package entry) gains `designInStudioPath?: string | null`.** Optional, additive. Right — a widening, and the prop is fed by `AppHeader`'s own `studioDesignPath`, so the dropdown row and the button share one gate and one target by construction (the `AppHeader.appIdentity-12201` test pins the hand-off and the member case).
2. **`AppSwitcher` now renders router `Link`s (「All apps」, the Studio row) and so needs a Router context.** Verified: at BASE `9646e2e` the component imported nothing from `react-router-dom`, and the real `MetadataProvider` it already required has no router dependence, so the requirement is new for this export. Judged NOT a Clause-② `(narrowing)`: the component's accept set (its props) only widened; what tightened is the render-environment precondition, and `react-router-dom` is already the package's declared peer dependency that its sibling chrome exports (`AppHeader`, `UnifiedSidebar`, `ConsoleLayout`) require. Its one in-tree mount (`AppHeader`) sits under a Router; the pinned objectstack sibling mounts it nowhere (its only mentions are CHANGELOG prose). Disclosed in the PR body's public-surface section. Right. The changeset body does not repeat the Router sentence — noted under ③, non-blocking.
3. **`AppHeader` (exported) · `app` variant markup changes, no prop change.** Platform mark and its preceding `PathSep` removed in app context only (`isApp = resolvedVariant === 'app'`; `home`, `orgs`, `studio` keep the mark); PREVIEW chip gated `!isApp` on the left and an `isApp` chip inserted before the Search group; the Studio button becomes `variant="outline"` with `Pencil`, label `hidden lg:inline`, moved to the first child of Group 2; `aria-label`/`title` read `topbar.editApp` instead of `topbar.designInStudio`; `data-testid="app-design-in-studio-button"`, the gate and `studioDesignPath` unchanged. These are UI-string and layout changes on a component with no API change. Right. `AppHeader.designInStudioNeedsAuthoring-10899` is untouched in the diff and green in CI against the new markup, as acceptance 6 requires.
4. **`UnifiedSidebar` (exported) · the `branding.logo` `SidebarHeader` is removed; the phone drawer header becomes `AppMark` (26 px) + app name + an 「All apps」 icon link.** The authorable key `branding.logo` keeps a mounted reader (the pill), so no authorable surface is removed — the reader moved, as the card says. `data-testid="mobile-sidebar-home"` stays on the way-out link to `useHomePath()`; `mobile-sidebar-app` is new. Right. Edge noted: the header now also requires `activeApp`, which is undefined only when no active app exists, a state in which there is no app context to leave.
5. **New modules `layout/AppMark.tsx` and `layout/appTileColors.ts` are internal.** Verified at the head: neither is listed in `packages/app-shell/src/layout/index.ts` nor in `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts`; the `exports` map (`.` and `./styles.css`) is unchanged. No export added or removed. Right.
6. **`appTileColors` imports `hexToHSL` and `contrastRatio` from `@object-ui/core`**, both exported from `packages/core/src/theme/ThemeEngine.ts`; `@object-ui/core` is a declared `workspace:*` dependency of app-shell. The author's hex reaches the DOM only as `--os-app-tile-*` custom properties read by static Tailwind utilities, with a `dark:` variant — the AGENTS.md section 2 carve-out, and the test asserts `style.backgroundColor` stays empty. Right.
7. **`@object-ui/i18n` · three keys added to all ten packs** (`topbar.editApp`, `layout.appSwitcher.allApps`, `layout.appSwitcher.editAppInStudio`, the last interpolating `app`), none removed. The key type derived from the packs widens — a published-surface change. zh/en values match the ruling's 「编辑应用」 / "Edit app", 「所有应用」 / "All apps", 「在 Studio 中编辑 APP」 / "Edit APP in Studio" (APP standing for the interpolated app label). `topbar.designInStudio` is kept and still has a live reader (`console/ai/LiveCanvas.tsx`); `home.nav` is no longer read by the drawer but is not removed. Right.
8. **Ruling items 1–6 against the diff.** (1) one asset at 22/22/26 px — `SIZE_CLASSES` sm/md, right; (2) icon left of the name in the pill, a glyph on every row, `icon`-on-`primaryColor` tile fallback with a neutral tile when no hex, and a failed logo URL falling back to the tile — right; (3) sidebar header gone, phone header icon + name — right; (4) platform mark gone in app context, kept on platform surfaces, 「All apps」 row as the way back — right; (5) PREVIEW chip beside the search box in app context — right; (6) labelled outline 「Edit app」 button with pencil at the left edge of the utility cluster, collapsing to the pencil with a `title` tooltip, same gate, same deep link, admin-only Studio row at the end of the dropdown next to 「All apps」, 「系统设置」 still listed as an app (it mounts through `ConsoleLayout`), Studio never listed (a stock boot registers no `studio` app — measured, no filter needed) — right.
9. **Acceptance 5 and 6 (tests).** `ConsoleLayout.appBrandingLogo-10827` now asserts the sidebar root has no image and no `[data-sidebar="header"]` while the real `AppSwitcher` draws the logo before the label; `AppSwitcher.appIdentity-12201` covers the logo, the `primaryColor` tile, the neutral tile, the load-failure fallback, 「All apps」 to the declared home, the Studio row's position and target, and `appTileColors` light/dark; `UnifiedSidebar.mobileAppHeader-12201` covers the 375 px header, fallback, way-out link and the 1280 px control; `AppHeader.appIdentity-12201` covers items 4–6 and the member case. Right.
10. **Docs** (`content/docs/guide/console-architecture.md`, `content/docs/guide/console.md`, `packages/app-shell/README.md`) follow the moved UI; none is a governed surface (Governed Surface Queue Guard green; no `.claude/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `docs/adr/**` or `skills/**` path in the file list). Right.

Nothing in the diff is judged wrong.

### ② Semver level

Changeset `.changeset/12201-app-identity-top-bar.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell: minor`, `@object-ui/i18n: minor`. Matches what the diff publishes — a new optional prop on an exported component (①.1) and three new i18n keys (①.7), both widenings; `minor` is the floor a `yes` declaration takes. No `major` (objectui AGENTS.md §9 版本号策略; Changeset Bump Policy green). Not `skip-changeset`: two released packages change source. The changeset body carries the consumer-facing description of both surfaces and the retained `topbar.designInStudio`.

`Clause-②:` line — PR body reads `Clause-②: yes`, fixed spelling, no arm. Right: the diff widens (①.1, ①.7) and, per ①.2, narrows no published accept set, so no `(narrowing)` arm, no breaking note and no ADR-0087 marker are owed. Changeset Declaration and Changeset Claim Re-read are green on the head.

### ③ Boundary flags

Every dev flag (os-dev-report 6122271226 and the PR body) and the one open question:

- **open_questions[0] — org context (`WorkspaceSwitcher` / `CurrentOrganizationIndicator`) still renders left of the app pill.** Answered: **A, keep it where it is.** Ruling item 4 places the pill relative to the platform mark and does not place the org context; the ruling was made on a single-org HotCRM environment, where neither control renders, so acceptance 1 (bar reads ［icon］HotCRM ▾ / Leads / …) holds as written. B and C are design calls the ruling did not make. Escalated as a note for the maintainer's staging screenshots: if a multi-org environment is in scope, the org context's place in app context needs its own ruling and a follow-up card — not this PR.
- **deviations[0] — file surface addition (three docs files).** Right; they describe exactly the UI moved, and the claim's exclusions (`app-shell/src/environment/`, `app-shell/src/console/home/`, objectstack) are respected in the file list.
- **deviations[1] — item 3 interpretation: the phone drawer header keeps a trailing 「All apps」 link.** Right: the ruling makes 「所有应用」 the way back to Home and on a phone the switcher that carries it is hidden, so the header must keep the old Home row's job; acceptance 4's "nothing else in the drawer changes" holds (the test asserts the rest of the drawer and the absence of a separate Home row).
- **deviations[2] — item 5 interpretation: PREVIEW chip moves right in app context only.** Right; item 5's reason ("so the bar's left edge is the app") applies only where the app pill leads.
- **deviations[3] — item 6 interpretation: label from `lg` (1024 px), pencil + native `title` below.** Right; satisfies acceptance 6's 1280 px text / 768 px pencil-with-tooltip pair. The tooltip being the native `title` (as the hammer's was) is acceptable, stated.
- **deviations[4] — Studio never listed as an app, no filter added.** Right; measured against the stock boot, stated.
- **NOT MEASURED — browser screenshots zh-CN/en at 1280/768/375 (acceptance 1–4 visual).** Honestly declared with its reason (no runnable backend in the container). The structural claims of acceptance 1–4 are pinned at DOM level by the four tests in ①.9 and green in CI. Escalated: the visual pass is the maintainer's staging screenshots after the pin move, as the PR body says. Not a contract failure.
- **NOT MEASURED locally — `check:eager-locale-catalogues`, `check:readme-exports`.** Measured by CI on this head: Docs Route Eager Closure Check and README Export Check are green. Closed.
- **out_of_scope_findings (3, carrier none).** Acknowledged: the AppShell dark-lightness-floor duplication, the missing 7256 source-scan row for the switcher's 「All apps」 (pinned behaviourally instead), and the stale console-architecture layout diagram. None blocks landing; none is a finding of this diff.
- **Reviewer's own flag — changeset prose.** The changeset body states the new prop and "No export is added or removed" but does not repeat the PR body's sentence that `AppSwitcher` now needs a Router context. Per ①.2 this is not a semver-level omission; it is a one-sentence gap in consumer-facing text. Non-blocking; the owning seat may add it in a later changeset if a consumer composing its own top bar ever asks.
- **Clause-② declaration present and well-formed** (`Clause-②: yes`, PR body); the claim's declaration (6121008577) matches.
